infrastructure_failures.reason: OCTOPUS_MODEL_PATH was omitted while offline mode was enabled; model resolution failed before engine initialization and no trace artifact was created.
OCTOPUS_COMMIT was omitted for the non-Git deployment; the measured attempt could not serialize its pinned source identity and no trace artifact was accepted.

original_budget_history.rule: Budget checked before each trace. The last already-started trace completed its triple, then no next block was launched; the configured budget was not increased.

controlled_repair_supplement.reason: explicit bounded authorization to close only the remaining paired traces

decision.rationale: The full policy fails the fixed 5% background point/bound gate at seeds [101]; the paired foreground interval does not establish an improvement.

flops_estimate_definition.formula: estimated forward trunk recompute FLOPs = 2 * parameters * recomputed_tokens
flops_estimate_definition.limitations: leading parameter-count estimate; omits attention quadratic work and is not hardware-measured FLOPs

model_oracle.calibration: synthetic shared-block model; not measured GPU parameters
model_oracle.scope: exact optimum of the fixed replay cost model; not GPU latency
